chapter.title: Act IV: The Longest Night
subtitle: Winter, Year One
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

quests.title: Sleep One Night, Then Follow Pip to the Inn
quests.subtitle: The Hearth has gone out.
description: Pip, at your door, out of breath: "The Hearth's out! It's been out since supper and Aunt Marnie is just standing there looking at it!"
Sleep one night in your own bed, then walk down the hill to the inn. Everyone in the valley is already inside it.
Opens the winter book and hands you 64 Firewood Bundles, a winter cloak and Marnie's cocoa.

tasks.title: Sleep one night, then walk into the inn

rewards.title: The Winter Book Opens
rewards.description: Next: 16 Firewood Bundles each to Marnie, Halden, Nella and Oda.

quests.title: Take 16 Firewood Bundles to Each of the Four Stacks
quests.subtitle: Marnie's, Halden's, Nella's and Oda's.
description: Oda, not looking up from the ledger: "Four houses, sixteen bundles each. That is sixty-four, which is exactly what you were given."
Put 16 Firewood Bundles into each of the four marked stacks in the inn's back room: Marnie's, Halden's, Nella's and Oda's. Any order is right.
Each of them gives something back, and Wisp lights a lantern path down the frozen river.

rewards.title: Four Stacks Filled
rewards.description: Next: walk the frozen river to the reed village and bring the Ribbits home.

quests.title: Walk the Frozen River and Bring the Ribbits Home
quests.subtitle: Follow Wisp's lanterns downstream and back.
description: Wisp: "The reeds is all ice now, and we are eleven with no roof. Can we be your neighbours nearer?"
The river is solid — walk it. Follow Wisp's lit lanterns downstream to the reed village and bring the Ribbits back to the inn.
Four Ribbits move into town for good, Wisp's arc closes, and Nella hands you her Ice Auger.

tasks.title: Reach the reed village and walk the Ribbits back to the inn

rewards.title: The Reed Village Comes In
rewards.description: Next: cook 12 bowls of Vegetable Soup for the long table at the inn.

quests.title: Cook 12 Vegetable Soup for the Long Table
quests.subtitle: One bowl for every seat.
description: Marnie, quietly: "I have fed this room for thirty years, and tonight I'm sitting down at it. Don't make a thing of it."
Cook 12 bowls of Vegetable Soup in the Cooking Pot and set them on the long table at the inn — one for every seat.
The Hearth relights, Marnie's arc closes, and the greenhouse shell goes up on the square.

rewards.title: The Hearth Is Lit Again
rewards.description: Next: glaze the greenhouse shell on the square — six windows, one door, eight planters.

quests.title: Cut the Ice and Catch 4 Muskellunge and 4 Rainbow Trout
quests.subtitle: Nella's Ice Auger goes through it.
description: Nella, flat: "Lake's a floor now, and the auger goes through it. Fish underneath don't know it's winter."
Cut a hole in the lake ice with Nella's Ice Auger, then catch 4 Muskellunge and 4 Rainbow Trout through it.
Winter tackle and two trophy mounts for the inn wall — and Nella has something to do until spring.

rewards.title: Two Trophies on the Inn Wall
rewards.description: Next: Halden's rounds — brew 8 Winter Tonics, one for each resident.

quests.title: Brew 8 Winter Tonics and Deliver One to Each Resident
quests.subtitle: At the still in the hedge garden.
description: Halden, slowly: "Eight people, eight bottles. I would go round myself, but they talk to you more than they talk to me."
Brew 8 Winter Tonics at the still in the hedge garden and hand one each to Marnie, Bram, Oda, Nella, Tobin, Wisp, Pip and Halden.
Halden's arc closes, and nobody in the valley gets sick this winter.

rewards.title: Nobody Gets Sick This Winter
rewards.description: Next: run 5 of Pip's courier parcels out of the Delivery Crate.

quests.title: Run 5 Courier Parcels From the Delivery Crate
quests.subtitle: One click each — the crate fills them.
description: Pip: "I am the courier and the satchel has my name on it! Five parcels and then cocoa!"
Take 5 Courier Parcels out of the Delivery Crate beside Oda's board and run them. One click each now — the crate fills them for you.
Pip's arc closes, the duckling finishes growing up, and the Duck Plushie is yours to keep.

rewards.title: Pip Is the Courier
rewards.description: Next: glaze the greenhouse shell — six windows, one door, eight planters on the marked bench.

quests.title: Glaze the Greenhouse Shell: 6 Windows, a Door, 8 Planters
quests.subtitle: 6 Oak Windows, 1 Oak Cottage Door, 8 Planters on the marked bench.
description: Nella: "Nothing grows in it yet. I'll sit in it anyway — it's the only quiet room in town."

Put one Oak Window in each of the six frames of the greenhouse shell on the square, hang the Oak Cottage Door, and set the 8 Planters on the marked bench. Every block is in this quest's packet. Any order is right.
A potting bench and seed trays go in — and the shell becomes a room the reactor's coolant loop can heat.

tasks.title: Six windows in, door hung, eight planters on the bench

rewards.title: The Greenhouse Is Glazed
rewards.description: Next: dress the inn for the solstice — twelve marked copper tiles.

quests.title: Dress the Inn's Twelve Marked Tiles for the Solstice
quests.subtitle: One Candle Holder, one Sconce and one Flower Box on each of 12 marked tiles.
description: Marnie: "Twelve spots. The solstice is the solstice, even in a year like this one has been."
Dress the inn: set a Candle Holder, a Sconce and a Flower Box on each of the twelve marked copper tiles. Every block is in this quest's packet. Any order is right.
Solstice decor for the whole inn, and Marnie's mulled cider.

tasks.title: All twelve marked copper tiles dressed

rewards.title: The Inn Is Dressed
rewards.description: Next: bake 4 Bread with Pip on the stool.

quests.title: Bake 4 Bread With Pip at the Inn Oven
quests.subtitle: He can reach if he stands on the stool.
description: Pip: "I can reach if I stand on the stool! Aunt Marnie says I can reach and Aunt Marnie is right!"
Bake 4 Bread at the inn's oven with Pip on the stool beside you.
Pip gets his own apron, and you keep the one loaf he made himself. It is not good. It is his.

rewards.title: Pip's Own Loaf
rewards.description: Next: shear the flock and make 4 Blankets — one per empty house.

quests.title: Shear the Flock and Make 4 Blankets
quests.subtitle: One blanket per empty house.
description: Marnie: "Four empty houses, four beds, four blankets. People arrive in spring, and beds should be made before they get here."
Shear the flock in the pasture, spin the wool at the loom in the inn, and make 4 Blankets — one for each empty house.
The four blankets go onto the four beds, and the loom set stays yours.

rewards.title: Four Beds Made
rewards.description: Next: nothing on this lane needs you yet — Oda's Counter is open while the reactor comes up.

quests.title: Set a Bench, a Shelf and a Lantern on Each Bathhouse Spot
quests.subtitle: Behind the inn, and every spot is marked.
description: Bram: "Built it, piped it, didn't furnish it. That end's not mine."
Set an Oak Bench, an Oak Shelf and a Lantern on each marked spot in the bathhouse behind the inn. Every block is in this quest's packet. Any order is right.
The bathhouse opens — the reactor's waste heat becomes a warm room people sit in.

tasks.title: Every marked spot in the bathhouse furnished

rewards.title: The Bathhouse Opens
rewards.description: Next: Tobin's safety check at the Reactor Terminal closes the act.

quests.title: Open the Works
quests.subtitle: Mine the ~90 marked blocks, then place the Waystone inside.
description: Tobin, fast: "Ninety blocks of fallen adit, I counted twice, and behind it is the entire works, and I have not slept."
Mine the roughly 90 marked blocks out of the collapsed adit into Josie's Works, then place the Waystone on the marked plinth inside.
The Works lights up, Josie's steel tools are on the bench, and there is a saddled horse in the stable.

tasks.title: Adit cleared and the Works Waystone placed inside

rewards.title: The Works Is Open
rewards.description: Next: run Energy Duct from the mill to the Works and fit 2 Energy Cells. The compass in this payout is already set to the Wandering Merchant's Tower.

quests.title: Run Energy Duct to the Works and Fit 2 Energy Cells
quests.subtitle: Duct from mill to Works, then 2 Thermal Energy Cells.
description: Bram: "Mill makes it, Works needs it, duct in between. That's the whole job."
Run Energy Duct from the mill to the Works, then install 2 Thermal Energy Cells at the Works end of the line.
The Works has power — which is what everything from here to the reactor runs on.

tasks.title: Energy Duct run from the mill to the Works

rewards.title: The Works Has Power
rewards.description: Next: take that compass to the Wandering Merchant's Tower and fetch the second Kettle Plate.

quests.title: Bring the Second Kettle Plate Back From the Merchant's Tower
quests.subtitle: The compass came with the Works payout.
description: Josie, in the margin: "Second plate went out with the tower trader. He always did want it more than he could read it."

Take the Explorer's Compass out of the Works payout — already set to the Wandering Merchant's Tower — click the Waystone standing at its gate, and bring the Kettle Plate out of the vault chest inside.
Josie's Turbine Notes come back with it: Bigger Reactors casings become craftable.

rewards.title: Turbine Notes in Hand
rewards.description: Next: build a Molecular Assembler and a 4k Crafting Storage into the Works network.

quests.title: Build a Molecular Assembler and a 4k Crafting Storage
quests.subtitle: Into the ME network at the Works.
description: Tobin: "You can keep making casings by hand, or the network can while you eat. I recommend the network, strongly, for reasons I have listed."
Craft 1 Molecular Assembler and 1 4k Crafting Storage and put them into the ME network at the Works.
CPU housing, four co-processors, four ME Interfaces — and Josie's yellorite map, which the next quest walks.

rewards.title: The Network Crafts For You
rewards.description: Next: follow Josie's yellorite map — it is in this payout — from the Works Waystone to the pocket.

quests.title: Bring Back 128 Uranium Ingots From Josie's Pocket
quests.subtitle: Josie's yellorite map, from the Works Waystone.
description: Tobin: "Her map puts the pocket a fixed walk from the Works waystone. Josie's surveys have never once been wrong."
Follow Josie's yellorite map from the Works Waystone to the pocket and process the ore into 128 Uranium Ingots — "yellorium", in Josie's shorthand.
Your own network auto-crafts 64 Reactor Casings while you walk back.

rewards.title: 64 Casings, Auto-Crafted
rewards.description: Next: assemble the vessel — 64 casings, terminal, 4 fuel rods, 4 control rods, access port.

quests.title: Build the Vessel
quests.subtitle: 64 Reactor Casings, 1 Terminal, 4 Fuel Rods, 4 Control Rods, 1 Access Port.
description: Bram: "Shell, terminal, fuel rods, control rods, one access port — build it square. Her drawing's on the wall behind you."
Gather 64 Reactor Casings, 1 Reactor Terminal, 4 Reactor Fuel Rods, 4 Reactor Control Rods and 1 Reactor Access Port, then assemble the vessel on the marked pad in the Works.
Computer port, redstone port, Josie's blueprint framed above it — and her turbine tuning page, which the next quest needs.

tasks.title: Vessel assembled and reading valid on the terminal

rewards.title: The Vessel Is Square
rewards.description: Next: build the turbine from Bram's crate to hold 1,800 RPM under load.

quests.title: Tune the Turbine to 1,800 RPM Under Load
quests.subtitle: Hold 1,800 RPM under load, then run /valley check turbine.
description: Bram: "Crate's got what it's got — blades, coils, casing. Get it to eighteen hundred RPM under load and hold it there."

Build the turbine from the fixed budget in Bram's crate so it holds 1,800 RPM under load without going over, then run /valley check turbine to confirm the reading. Josie's tuning page from the last quest has the numbers.
The lever goes live, and her own figures get pencilled into your journal margin.

tasks.title: Turbine holds 1,800 RPM under load — confirm with /valley check turbine

rewards.title: 1,800 RPM, Held
rewards.description: Next: run the coolant loop to the 6 greenhouse heaters and the bathhouse tank.

quests.title: Duct the Coolant Loop to the Greenhouse and the Bathhouse
quests.subtitle: Josie's rule: the heat goes to the town.
description: Josie's rule, in her own hand: "The waste heat goes to the town, not the sky. Anything else is a fire you paid for twice."
Run Fluid Duct and Energy Duct from the reactor to the 6 greenhouse heaters on the square, and to the bathhouse tank behind the inn.
Greenhouse Glass becomes craftable world-wide — the valley can grow food in January.

tasks.title: All 6 greenhouse heaters connected and running

rewards.title: Greenhouse Glass Unlocked
rewards.description: Next: fetch Bram from the mill, and take the cocoa with you.

quests.title: Bring Bram to the Inn With a Hot Cocoa
quests.subtitle: Take Bram's token from the mill and give him 1 Hot Cocoa.
description: Marnie: "He'll say the mill needs him at midnight in January. Take the cocoa anyway, and don't argue with him about it."
Walk to the mill, click Bram to take his token, and hand him 1 Hot Cocoa. He will say no. Bring him anyway.
Bram's arc closes, his father's wrench is yours, and the lever quest opens.

rewards.title: Bram Sits Down
rewards.description: Next: place the last 17 lamp posts, mill to square to lake.

quests.title: Place the Last 17 Lamp Posts, Mill to Square to Lake
quests.subtitle: Lamps 39 of 40. One post stays bare.
description: Josie, page forty: "Forty posts, mill to square to lake. I counted them on my fingers before I could count to forty."
Place the last 17 lamp posts on the marked spots, mill to square to lake. Any order is right. When the last post goes down the duct runs itself along the line.
Lamps 39 of 40. One post stays bare on purpose: Josie's porch.

tasks.title: All 17 marked lamp posts placed, mill to square to lake

rewards.title: Lamps 39 / 40
rewards.description: Next: Tobin's safety check at the Reactor Terminal. Then Bram pulls the lever.

quests.title: Verify the Three Readings, Then Hand Bram the Lever
quests.subtitle: Act IV finale — the Longest Night.
description: Tobin, calm for once: "Fuel, coolant, rods — I check them, I sign it, Bram pulls it. That's the order, and I wrote it down twice."
Open the Reactor Terminal in the Works and verify all three readings — fuel level, coolant flow, control-rod insertion — then tell Tobin the numbers are good and hand Bram the lever.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.
Tonight, for the first time in eleven years, the valley keeps its own lights on.

tasks.title: Fuel, coolant flow and control rods verified on the Reactor Terminal

rewards.title: The Longest Night
rewards.description: Next: sleep one night, then walk the square with Marnie. It is spring again.
